{{Quote|I know you've all heard the stories of the original Alkhara, the notorious bandit who teamed up with the Sand People and killed a garrison of policemen on Tatooine years and years ago.  Well, Alkhara is long since dead, but his memory has started a movement.|General Zaster|<ref name="SWG:SC" />}}
'''Zaster''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Zaster held the rank of [[General/Legends|General]] and commanded the [[Imperial Second Division]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During this time, Zaster was very concerned about the expansion of the criminal group known as the [[Alkhara Bandits]]. General Zaster eventually sent an official notice to all Imperial personnel on Tatooine in order to reinforce patrols in the areas concerned by the Bandits' activities.<ref name="SWG:SC" />
